steps.name: When I simulate OAuth callback for a new influencer without consent cookies
Then the response should indicate consent required error

expected 400 for missing/invalid consent cookies; body: {"timestamp":"2026-11-10T09:27:08.319","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"All required consent cookies must be accepted before registration.","path":"/api/test/auth/register-without-firebase","requestId":"REQ-d9643234","messageKey":"error.consent.missing_consents"}
And no user should be created from the OAuth callback
no user id must be stored when the callback is rejected
